QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] Revolution! High-speed Warship Nibelung
QuestInfo.0: You fought off the Mechanized Maverick Platoon, but now the #o9601832# warship has arrived. Destroy it and clear the path to the landing zone.
QuestInfo.1: Engage the enemy #o9601832# warship. Destroy it, and you destroy the comms hub for the entire enemy fleet. They'll protect it well. Don't let your guard down.
QuestInfo.2: You've destroyed the Nibelung warship. Between that and the loss of Bergamot, the enemy now has no clear commander on land or in the air. Leave the rest to humanity's ultimate weapon.
